runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification; touching timestamps is not verification. Existing records remain active when a new sweep does not rediscover them; absence from search is not deactivation evidence.
runSummary.note: Fresh 12.9.2026 05:33 sweep actually searched 11 source families: Profesia, direct-company careers, LinkedIn Jobs public index, Worki, Brigada.sk, Kariera/Zoznam, Praca za rohom, Pretlak/StartupJobs/WordPress Jobs, Upwork, Reddit/WordPress communities and Facebook public indexing. No new promotion-grade unique hit cleared location, language, qualification, schedule/economics, freshness and trust gates. Profesia surfaced very fresh Bratislava customer-care/admin/technical inventory: Partner Telekom customer care is strongly retail/sales oriented; Henkel Coordinator Digital Marketing and Kistler HR Administrator carry English/international-office burden; Ptacek warehouse is physical/logistics; Industrytech service technician is locally attractive at 1800-2200 EUR but explicitly requires electrotechnical/mechanical education, one year technologist experience and automation experience. LinkedIn re-surfaced Wolt Support Associate full/part time with B2 English and shift/weekend work. Upwork surfaced several Worldwide WordPress/VA jobs, but the credible ones were either economically weak (30 USD for 120 AI articles; 6 USD fixed automation QA), hard-skill/English heavy, or low-trust generic VA listings. Reddit returned freelancer self-promotion rather than hiring demand. Facebook produced 0 concrete publicly verifiable hiring posts.

developmentBacklogAdded.title: Fresh listing pay/title conflict check
developmentBacklogAdded.reason: Detect when a newly indexed title appears with different compensation or location variants across category pages and employer pages. Require canonical-detail resolution before promotion so hourly sweeps do not treat an index refresh or sibling vacancy as a brand-new job.

developmentBacklogAdded.title: Qualification evidence-gap score
developmentBacklogAdded.reason: For attractive technical roles, separately score mandatory education, years of directly matching practice and named domain experience against evidence in the candidate profile. This prevents high pay and topical keywords such as automation or service from masking a hard qualification gap.
